|game_text=Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. [[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Block 2){{!}}Boba Fett]] may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]; it is the current text. No published AI image prints it; the image here ([[:File:VB5-44EAI-Mace_Windu_AI-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]) is a CardMaker recreation of the AI card with this text. The Players Committee AI card image shows the original text (see [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip [[:File:VB5-44E-Mace_Windu.png]] of the base card)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Mace’s game text may not be canceled (except at Senate). During battle, Mace may fire one weapon twice. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-macewinduai-pre.gif]], numbered 44E) prints the same text. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a version (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): rephrased: “Mace's game text may not be canceled (except at Senate) and he may fire one weapon twice per battle. Boba Fett may not add battle destiny draws here. Immune to attrition.” Shown for the AI printing on the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013), where the entry is labelled “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”<ref name="cl-1250_45ai-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>. No published AI image prints this text; the image on [[Mace Windu (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] is a CardMaker recreation.
